displayName: Triage my inbox and draft replies
summary: Flag urgent emails and save draft replies ready to send.

useCases.title: Triage my inbox and draft replies
useCases.message: Help me get on top of my inbox. Go through my unread emails, flag what needs attention, and draft replies for the ones that need a response. You might want to check my sent emails to match my tone before drafting. Save each draft so I can review before anything gets sent.
